Final for Publication

1841 N. Orleans Street (“Subject Property”)
Type I Zoning Map Amendment

Narrative and Plans

The Applicant, Matthew Denison, is proposing a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment from a RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District to a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District. The Subject Property
is improved with a 3-story, brick and framed building.

The Applicant owns the adjacent property to the south, 1839 N. Orleans Street. The Applicant
proposes to convey twelve (12) feet by one hundred twenty-five (125) feet of the Subject
Property to the adjacent 1839 N. Orleans Street property and bring the Subject Property into
compliance by utilizing this Type | Zoning Map Amendment.

The existing building is approximately 3,820 square foot home, with an 2 car garage. The
overall height of the building is 45 feet, which is allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The Subject Property is unique because the existing building was built prior to the Chicago
Zoning Code. Therefore, the current setback requirements of the Chicago Zoning Code did not

apply at the time the building was constructed.

Proposed Zoning: RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District to RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District

plans.
